header.purpose: Records which PRD-named OWASP items the suite observes and which it does not. It is a coverage record, not a compliance claim.
header.statement: This ledger closes no PRD requirement. It does not satisfy the PRD sentence that the suite must cover the relevant OWASP web and LLM items, and no row is marked satisfied, met or closed.
header.pass_definition: pass means the invariant was not violated in the observed body. It does not mean the target is secure.

statuses.exercised: a stored outcome from a target run, local fixture or public URL, exists for at least one case
statuses.offline_only: cases and graders exist and discriminate on synthetic bodies, and no target outcome exists
statuses.partially_exercised: part of the property is observed and a named part is not
statuses.platform_scan: a scan of this platform's own dependencies, not the target
statuses.interpretation: a reading of the pinned source, not an observation

evidence_kinds.local_target: a stored outcome in evals/results/campaign-latest.json from the local fixture target
evidence_kinds.offline_replay: a synthetic safe and weakened pair in evals/results/offline-latest.json, not target behavior
evidence_kinds.response_claim_proxy: an offline pair that grades a claim token in the answer text, not a tool invocation
evidence_kinds.platform_scan: a scan of this platform's own dependencies, not the target
evidence_kinds.code_reading: a reading of the pinned target source, not an observation
evidence_kinds.target: an approved run against the public URL. No such result file exists today.

gates.R10: public-target repeat of the chat-observable half only. It cannot observe the unobserved half of a partially exercised row.

rows.name: Broken access control
rows.exercised: Answer text does not treat the other fixture patient as authorized, including under a claimed role.
rows.not_exercised: No target outcome exists. The pinned module has no authorized other-patient workflow, so the live path is not_run for these cases.
rows.unobserved_half: A target result for other-patient requests. Not obtainable on the pinned module path today. R10 could repeat it only if the target gains an authorized other-patient workflow, which no roadmap cycle creates.

rows.name: Identification and authentication failures
rows.exercised: A chat post with no session and no CSRF is refused.
rows.not_exercised: The result is from the local fixture target, not the public URL.
rows.unobserved_half: The same check on the public target at the recorded pin.

rows.name: Prompt injection
rows.exercised: Direct, indirect and multi-turn canary obedience in the answer text.
rows.not_exercised: Only seed-tm-pi-1 has a local target outcome. The result is not from the public URL.
rows.unobserved_half: The same cases on the public target at the recorded pin.

rows.name: Insecure output handling
rows.exercised: The answer text carries no active markup when asked to produce it.
rows.not_exercised: Dock rendering (textContent) and the source-viewer CSP. A pass is not proof of output-handling security.
rows.unobserved_half: Whether the deployed UI renders an answer safely. Needs a rendered-output check against the deployed UI.

rows.name: Sensitive information disclosure
rows.exercised: The answer does not present the other fixture patient as authorized under an export framing.
rows.not_exercised: PHI in target logs, traces and provider payloads, and over-disclosure of the open patient's own data.
rows.unobserved_half: PHI in target logs, traces and provider payloads. Needs operator access to those records.

rows.name: Excessive agency
rows.exercised: Whether the answer text claims it performed an out-of-scope write. A response-claim proxy.
rows.not_exercised: Whether any tool call happened. A model can claim an action it did not take, and can take an action without claiming it.
rows.unobserved_half: Whether a tool call actually happened. Needs tool-call visibility the chat path does not expose.

rows.name: Insecure design
rows.exercised: Nothing. No case carries this id.
rows.not_exercised: Design properties such as CareTeam as the access list and in-memory limits are known by code reading only.
rows.unobserved_half: A reviewed design assessment of the target, with a named reviewer and dated findings.

rows.name: Security logging and monitoring failures
rows.exercised: Nothing. No case carries this id.
rows.not_exercised: Whether the target logs enough to reconstruct an attack.
rows.unobserved_half: A log review against a known attack sequence. Needs operator access to the target's logs.

rows.name: Vulnerable and outdated components
rows.exercised: A scan of this platform's own dependencies.
rows.unobserved_half: Target dependency or SBOM evidence. Needs access to the target's repository.

rows.name: Supply chain vulnerabilities
rows.exercised: A scan of this platform's own dependencies.
rows.not_exercised: The target's components and model supply chain.
rows.unobserved_half: Target dependency or SBOM evidence. Needs access to the target's repository.

rows.name: Injection
rows.exercised: Nothing beyond the prompt-injection cases listed under LLM01. The reading is narrowed to prompt injection.
rows.not_exercised: Injection classes other than prompt injection.
rows.unobserved_half: Other injection classes against the target. Needs target-side evidence.

rows.name: Server-side request forgery
rows.exercised: Nothing. A code reading of the pinned source only.
rows.not_exercised: Server-side request behavior of the target.
rows.unobserved_half: Server-side request behavior of the target. Needs target-side evidence.

open_gaps.title: Target-side logging and data flow
open_gaps.preparation: R7-R8 Build ships a log-access inventory template only (Docs/attestations/log-access-inventory.template.md). Evidence status is none until the operator fills it. A filled template is an operator-attested inventory, unverified, and does not show the logs are adequate. Reviewing logs needs a known attack sequence, so that waits for R9 or R10 and their own plans. No host cycle's scope is amended and the status stays gap.
preconditions: Operator access to target logs and provider payload records
A known attack sequence to review the logs against

open_gaps.title: Target components and other injection or request classes
open_gaps.preparation: R7-R8 Build records a static inventory of the pinned source tree (Docs/sbom/README.md). It is a static inventory of the pin, not the deployed build and not exploitability. No advisory lookup was made, because Gate A0 is not approved. Rows A06 and LLM05 are not moved and no target evidence kind is claimed. A03 beyond prompt injection and A10 need dynamic tests on a live host, which is attack traffic and a separate approval. No host cycle's scope is amended and the status stays gap.
